description: Looks up a room or scheduled watch party by its 5-character code (from create_watch_room or from a ScreenParty link such as …/s/AB2CD or …room.html?room=AB2CD). Returns its title, start time, whether guests can enter yet and whether people are in it right now. Use it to answer "when does it start?" or "is it open?". Read-only; it never reveals who is in the room.
name: get_watch_party

code.description: Error code when ok is false.

live.description: Someone is in the room now.

ok.description: false when the call failed; then code says why.

title: Look up a watch party
